text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth didn't show up for 
training, so I went out looking for her. I 
found her performing at a shopping mall.
choice_data_list:
Training time has already passed, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Affrettando! Has it gotten that late 
already?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I was asked to play some music to liven 
up the mall, and I suppose I got a bit 
carried away."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry! I had no intention of 
wasting our precious time together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I warned Sounds of Earth to be careful 
from then on.
